simple.meaning: דַּיָּה (dayâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a falcon (from its rapid flight).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דַּיָּה (H1772) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 14:13, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דַּיָּה (H1772) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דַּיָּה (H1772) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דַּיָּה (dayâh) / H1772 is traced through Deuteronomy 14:13, Isaiah 34:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
